# Poll Maker

> > Poll Maker is a free, unlimited poll creation platform with live reporting and real-time audience engagement capabilities.

Poll Maker enables users to create unlimited polls in seconds with no signup required, offering live reporting dashboards and integration options. The platform serves workplace teams, event organizers, and researchers with pre-built question templates across employee engagement, meetings, feedback collection, and team bonding scenarios.

## Key Topics

- Poll creation
- Live polling
- Survey questions
- Team engagement
- Employee feedback
- Meeting facilitation
- Workplace culture
- Anonymous voting
- Question templates
- Event polling
- Data collection
- Decision-making
- Real-time reporting
- Free polls
- Audience engagement
